arxiv-2112-08337.title: Assessing TESS’s Yield of Rocky Planets Around Nearby M Dwarfs
arxiv-2112-08337.creator: Madison T. Brady, Jacob L. Bean
arxiv-2112-08337.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Madison T. Brady, Jacob L. Bean. Terrestrial planets are easier to detect around M dwarfs than other types of stars, making them promising for next-generation atmospheric characterization studies. The TESS mission has greatly increased the number of known M dwarf planets that we can use to perform population studies, allowing us to explore how the rocky planet occurrence rate varies with host radius, following in the footsteps of past work with Kepler data.

arxiv-2203-16898.title: Semantic-shape Adaptive Feature Modulation for Semantic Image Synthesis
arxiv-2203-16898.creator: Zhengyao Lv, Xiaoming Li, Zhenxing Niu, Bing Cao, Wangmeng Zuo✉
arxiv-2203-16898.description: Abstract Recent years have witnessed substantial progress in semantic image synthesis, it is still challenging in synthesizing photo-realistic images with rich details. Most previous methods focus on exploiting the given semantic map, which just captures an object-level layout for an image.

arxiv-2307-16657.title: Cell decomposition and dual boundary complexes of character varieties
arxiv-2307-16657.creator: Tao Su
arxiv-2307-16657.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Tao Su. The weak geometric P=W conjecture of L. Simpson asserts that for any smooth Betti moduli space ℳ B \mathcal{M}_{B} of complex dimension d d over a punctured Riemann surface, the dual boundary complex 𝔻 ​ ∂ ℳ B \mathbb{D}\partial\mathcal{M}_{B} is homotopy equivalent to a ( d − 1 ) (d-1) -dimensional sphere.

arxiv-2311-01564.title: InSAR-Informed In-Situ Monitoring for Deep-Seated Landslides: Insights from El Forn (Andorra)
arxiv-2311-01564.description: Abstract Monitoring deep-seated landslides via borehole instrumentation can be an expensive and labor-intensive task. This work focuses on assessing the fidelity of Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar (InSAR) as it relates to subsurface ground motion monitoring, as well as understanding uncertainty in modeling active landslide displacement for the case study of the in-situ monitored El Forn deep-seated landslide in Canillo, Andorra.

arxiv-2407-19839.title: Additive manufacturing applications in astronomy: a review
arxiv-2407-19839.creator: Younes Chahid, Carolyn Atkins, Greg Lister, Rhys Tuck, Stephen Watson, Katherine Morris, David Isherwood, Jonathan Strachan, Joel Harman, Pearachad Chartsiriwattana, Deno Stelter, Werner Laun
arxiv-2407-19839.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Younes Chahid, Carolyn Atkins, Greg Lister, Rhys Tuck, Stephen Watson, Katherine Morris, David Isherwood, Jonathan Strachan, Joel Harman, Pearachad Chartsiriwattana, Deno Stelter, Werner Laun. Despite the established role of additive manufacturing (AM) in aerospace and medical fields, its adoption in astronomy remains low. Encouraging AM integration in a risk-averse community necessitates documentation and dissemination of previous case studies.

arxiv-2412-00219.title: Bernstein-Von Mises for semiparametric mixtures
arxiv-2412-00219.creator: Stefan Franssen, Jeanne Nguyen, Aad van der Vaart
arxiv-2412-00219.description: Abstract 1 Introduction Statistical modelling often involves striking a delicate balance between flexibility and simplicity. While parametric models offer a straightforward representation of data, they may fail to capture the intricate complexities present in real-world phenomena. On the other hand, nonparametric models provide remarkable flexibility, but their complexity can also be a drawback.

arxiv-2508-15280.title: Non-Commutative weak measurements: Entanglement, Symmetry Breaking, and the Role of Readout
arxiv-2508-15280.creator: Yuanchen Zhao, Li Rao, Dong E. Liu
arxiv-2508-15280.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yuanchen Zhao, Li Rao, Dong E. Liu. The preparation of long-range entangled (LRE) states via quantum measurements is a promising strategy, yet its stability against realistic, non-commuting measurement noise remains a critical open question. Here, we systematically investigate the rich phase structure emerging from a minimal model of competing, non-commuting weak measurements: nearest-neighbor Ising ( Z i ​ Z j Z_{i}Z_{j} ) and single-qubit transverse ( X i X_{i} ) operators.

arxiv-2509-19928.title: Measuring Prosody Diversity in Zero-Shot TTS: A New Metric, Benchmark, and Exploration
arxiv-2509-19928.creator: Yifan Yang, Bing Han, Hui Wang, Long Zhou, Wei Wang, Mingyu Cui, Xu Tan, Xie Chen
arxiv-2509-19928.description: Abstract Prosody diversity is essential for achieving naturalness and expressiveness in zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS). However, frequently used acoustic metrics capture only partial views of prosodic variation and correlate poorly with human perception, leaving the problem of reliably quantifying prosody diversity underexplored.

arxiv-2510-06526.title: A Geometrical Approach to Neutrino Oscillation Parameters
arxiv-2510-06526.creator: Mohammad Ful Hossain Seikh
arxiv-2510-06526.description: Abstract We propose a geometric hypothesis for neutrino mixing: that twice the sum of the three mixing angles equals 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} , forming a Euclidean triangle. This condition leads to a predictive relation among the mixing angles and, through trigonometric constraints, enables reconstruction of the mass-squared splittings.

arxiv-2602-11850.title: Free Lunch for Stabilizing Rectified Flow Inversion
arxiv-2602-11850.creator: Chenru Wang, Beier Zhu, Chi Zhang
arxiv-2602-11850.description: Abstract Rectified-Flow (RF)-based generative models have recently emerged as strong alternatives to traditional diffusion models, demonstrating state-of-the-art performance across various tasks. By learning a continuous velocity field that transforms simple noise into complex data, RF-based models not only enable high-quality generation, but also support training-free inversion, which facilitates downstream tasks such as reconstruction and editing.

pmc-10729760.title: Highly Accurate Sequence- and Position-Independent Error Profiling of DNA Synthesis and Sequencing
pmc-10729760.creator: Huiran Yeom, Namphil Kim, Amos Chungwon Lee, Jinhyun Kim, Hamin Kim, Hansol Choi, Seo Woo Song, Sunghoon Kwon, Yeongjae Choi
pmc-10729760.description: A comprehensive error analysis of DNA-stored data during processing, such as DNA synthesis and sequencing, is crucial for reliable DNA data storage. Both synthesis and sequencing errors depend on the sequence and the transition of bases of nucleotides; ignoring either one of the error sources leads to technical challenges in minimizing the error rate.

pmc-11360450.title: Zoonotic Enteric Nematodes and Dermatophytes in Cat Cafés: An Investigation in the Bangkok Metropolitan Area, Thailand
pmc-11360450.creator: Phakjira Sanguansook, Siwaporn Tuangpermsub, Boonyakorn Leelakarnsakul, Sutida Phaisansomsuk, Vachira Hunprasit, Laura Del Río, Waree Niyomtham, Nuvee Prapasarakul, Woraporn Sukhumavasi
pmc-11360450.description: Simple SummaryThe cat café has emerged as a popular and growing business in Thailand, allowing customers to have direct contact with cats, a species known to harbor certain zoonotic diseases. Given the previous reports of zoonotic parasites and fungal pathogens in the cat population in Thailand, there is a potential for these pathogens to be present in cat cafés.

pmc-12618273.title: Phenotypic Spectrum and Diagnostic Challenges in Klippel‐Trenaunay Syndrome: A Case Series
pmc-12618273.creator: Marya Hameed, Tooba Ali, Md Ariful Haque
pmc-12618273.description: Klippel‐Trénaunay syndrome (KTS) is a rare congenital disorder characterized by the triad of capillary malformations, venous varicosities, and soft tissue or bony hypertrophy. This case series highlights rare and atypical presentations of KTS, emphasizing the importance of a multidisciplinary diagnostic approach.

pmc-12787278.title: Frailty Impact on Periprocedural Outcomes of Atrial Fibrillation Ablation
pmc-12787278.creator: Eran Leshem, Daniel Carny, Adam Folman, Mark Kazatsker, Ariel Roguin, Gilad Margolis
pmc-12787278.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: Frail patients undergoing AF ablation face elevated periprocedural risks. However, prior studies often examined composite or long-term outcomes and did not stratify acute complication risks by frailty severity. Objective: The objective of this study was to assess the impact of frailty, measured by the Hospital Frailty Risk Score (HFRS) on in-hospital outcomes after AF ablation, and to delineate the risk of specific acute complications across frailty levels. Methods: We analyzed a national inpatient cohort of AF ablation hospitalizations (2016–2021).

pmc-13562896.title: Water Quality Index: Physicochemical and Microbiological Risk Assessment of Drinking Water in Maya City, Eastern Ethiopia
pmc-13562896.creator: Andarge Zelalem, Tsegu Kiros, Tessema Toru, Abera Atumo Ante, Temesegen Achamo Orisho, Yehararwork Abebaw, Deressa Boja Adugna, Getachew Teshome Tilahun
pmc-13562896.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to evaluate drinking water quality across different sources and seasons and to develop Water Quality Index (WQI) based on selected physicochemical and microbial parameters in Maya City Administration, Ethiopia.MethodsDrinking water samples (n=120) were analyzed for microbial and physicochemical analysis. Safety indicator bacteria were detected and counted using petrifilm, while the physicochemical parameters were determined using standard procedures.
